title: Retail collaborative drug therapy management scope
rule_summary: Retail CDTM is limited to referred and consenting adults, the diseases and actions authorized by statute, the supervising physician's agreement, and other statutory setting restrictions.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply retail scope requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Retail collaborative drug therapy management scope

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing retail scope with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
